lessons.title: Verify Before You Share
lessons.objective: Check news before passing it on
lessons.hook: What do you do with a message that makes you want to forward it right now?

sources.author: The Qur'an
sources.quote: If a vicious character brings you some news, verify it, lest you should visit [harm] on some people out of ignorance

lessons.summary: Surah al-Hujurat 49:6 tells those who have faith to verify news brought by a vicious character, so that they do not harm people out of ignorance and then regret it.

questions.prompt: What does 49:6 say to do with news from a vicious character?
Why does the verse say to verify?
options: So as not to harm people out of ignorance
To be first with the news
questions.explanation: The verse warns against visiting harm on people out of ignorance.

lessons.title: Made to Know One Another
lessons.hook: Why would diversity be built into humanity?

sources.author: The Qur'an
sources.quote: We created you from a male and a female, and made you nations and tribes that you may identify yourselves with one another.

lessons.summary: Surah al-Hujurat 49:13 says that people were created from a male and a female and made into nations and tribes so that they may identify one another.

questions.prompt: Why were people made into nations and tribes, according to 49:13?
options: So that they may identify themselves with one another
So that one may rule over the rest
questions.explanation: The verse gives the reason: that you may identify yourselves with one another.

lessons.title: Fair Disagreement
lessons.hook: How do you disagree without turning it into a fight?

sources.author: The Qur'an
sources.quote: Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good advice and dispute with them in a manner that is best.

lessons.summary: Surah an-Nahl 16:125 asks for wisdom and good advice in inviting to the way of the Lord, and for disputing in the best manner.

questions.prompt: In what manner does 16:125 say to dispute?
options: In a manner that is best
In a manner that is loudest
questions.explanation: The verse says: dispute with them in a manner that is best.

questions.prompt: An online disagreement is getting personal. Which response fits the verse?
options: Return to wisdom and good advice
questions.explanation: The verse asks for wisdom and good advice.

sources.author: The Qur'an
sources.quote: in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of night and day, there are signs for those who possess intellect

questions.explanation: The verse says signs for those who possess intellect.

lessons.title: Don't Waste
lessons.hook: What do you throw away that you could have used?

sources.author: The Qur'an
sources.quote: eat and drink, but do not waste; indeed, He does not like the wasteful.

lessons.summary: Surah al-A'raf 7:31 permits eating and drinking, but says not to waste, because Allah does not like the wasteful.

questions.prompt: What does 7:31 say about eating and drinking?
options: Eat and drink, but do not waste
questions.explanation: The verse says: eat and drink, but do not waste.

questions.prompt: You are served more than you can finish. Which choice fits the verse?
options: Take what you will use and avoid waste
questions.explanation: The verse says Allah does not like the wasteful.

lessons.title: The Middle Way With Money
lessons.hook: Where is the balance between spending too much and too little?

sources.author: The Qur'an
sources.quote: neither wasteful nor tightfisted when spending, but balanced between these [two extremes]

lessons.summary: Surah al-Furqan 25:67 describes those who are neither wasteful nor tightfisted when spending, but balanced between the two extremes.

questions.explanation: The verse says balanced between these two extremes.

questions.prompt: You receive a gift of money. Which plan fits the verse?
options: Spend with balance, neither wasting nor hoarding
questions.explanation: The verse praises balance between waste and tightfistedness.
